desc: The Range XP 2.0 is built on Weatherby's newest bolt action rifle platform, the Model 307. Meant to complement the historic Mark V and Vanguard lineups, the Model 307 action is a 2-Lug, fully cylindrical action compatible with many aftermarket accessories. Model 307 is designed to accommodate the vast offerings of stocks, triggers, rails, mounts, and magazines that exist in today's marketplace. The Range XP 2.0 is a shooter-friendly platform that can dominate the shooting range or the mountain range. The upgraded hand-painted stock is sure to make this rifle stand out.
